$Comment: A seasonal contract for the Hallow's Eve event. The plain condition at the top of Requires is that event's running switch (ziggfreedcommon:feature, Param Hallows_Eve_Live, Min 1): while it reads on, the Daily board can post this contract in its Seasonal slot, and the rest of the year, or on a server without the Hallow's Eve pack, it is never posted. Keep that condition at the top level - inside AllOf, AnyOf or Not it turns into an ordinary lock, and the contract would sit on the board all year, locked. A player who took it before the event ended still finds it on the board's Mine tab, to hand in and claim. The target is the event's own Hollow Ghoul role, so ordinary ghouls do not count here.
